description: This file implements the delete functionality for articles, including a command, validation, and a query handler to delete an article specified by its slug.

classes.name: CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the article slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete operation for an article identified by its slug, performing database lookup and removal.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion of the article with the given slug, throws a RestException if not found, and saves the changes.
